scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,admin,api -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=api && npm run build --workspace=admin && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=api && npm run typecheck --workspace=admin && npx tsc -p packages/kidq-player && (cd web && npx tsc --noEmit)
